episodes.synopsis: U20 has ended and Noa Hoshizaki appears before Chrono and demands a cardfight.
episodes.title: Chrono Taken

episodes.synopsis: Dumjid pays Kouji Ibuki a surprise visit at his branch office. Ibuki stands against Dumjid, with his new Messiah.
episodes.title: A Written Challenge from the Apostle

episodes.synopsis: Shion Kiba encounters Valeos, who seeks to obtain or destroy the sacred sword Fides. To ensure his goal, Valeos summons the forbidden Zeroth Dragon.
episodes.title: Blue Wave Marshal, Valeos

episodes.synopsis: Chrono Shindou and Tsuneto encounter Gastille while trapped in Relics. Meanwhile, on Earth, Valeos challenges Taiyou Asukawa, using the power of his Zeroth Dragon.
episodes.title: Zeroth Dragon

episodes.synopsis: Kazuma Shouji and Kazumi Onimaru try to figure out a way to bring Chrono Shindou and his friends back to Earth. Dumjid, however, seeks revenge, and tries to stop Kazuma.
episodes.title: Dragon Burning with Vengeance

episodes.synopsis: Toshiki Kai, Arata Nishizawa, and Makoto Asada meet up with Kamui Katsuragi and Misaki Tokura, who plan on invading the Apostle's secret laboratory. Awaiting them was the diffrided Sousuke Wakamizu.
episodes.title: Purging Overlord

episodes.synopsis: An illusion obstructs the fighters, who are fighting to destroy the Relics Generators around the world in order to save Chrono Shindou and the others that were taken. And the shocking scene that Chrono saw while fighting in Relics is...?
episodes.title: Relics Crisis

episodes.synopsis: The scheming Dumjid aims for the recuperating Chrono. To protect Chrono and his friends, Tokoha Anjou stands up to the threat of the Zeroth Dragons with the card entrusted by Miguel's illusion.
episodes.title: The Future We Secured

episodes.synopsis: Arata Nishizawa and Makoto Asada have reunited with Noa Hoshizaki, who was released from Chaos Breaker. However, the trio is ambushed by Gredora and Darkface, who were chasing Chaos Breaker.
episodes.title: Evil Governor Gredora

episodes.synopsis: Kamui Katsuragi and Misaki Tokura reach Arata Nishizawa and Makoto Asada. Kamui, pushed by his fighting spirit and manly feelings, faces off against Gredora, the strongest enemy. Will Kamui be strong enough to defy the power of a Zeroth Dragon?!
episodes.title: The Man's Finishing Hold

episodes.synopsis: Chrono Shindou and the others hold a Christmas Party for Arata Nishizawa and Makoto Asada after they return home to Japan. Meanwhile, Kouji Ibuki and Gastille face off in a dramatic showdown.
episodes.title: Evil God Bishop Gastille

episodes.synopsis: Kouji Ibuki lays on the verge of death, then hands his Deck and Fight over to Chrono Shindou. Will Chrono be able to defeat Gastille with Ibuki’s Deck?
episodes.title: The Curse Known as Fate

episodes.synopsis: The ones who target Chrono Shindou, the strongest candidate for becoming "Gyze's Vessel", are the three Apostles. Kazuma Shouji and Taiyou Asukawa fight to defend Chrono from the Zeroth Dragon of Star Gate, which is under the command of Chaos Breaker.
episodes.title: The Vessel of Gyze

episodes.synopsis: Chrono Shindou, who reached to the place where Taiyou Asukawa and Kazuma Shouji fought, witnessed a spectacular scene. At the same time, the fight where Chrono definitely can't lose open its curtains.
episodes.title: The Beginning of the End

episodes.synopsis: Units who have been at his side, and then Kazuma Shouji... Chrono Shindou was tormented by the loss of many precious things, and Kazumi Onimaru challenges him to a card fight. And the future that the two wished for at the end of the fight is――
episodes.title: Sworn Fight

episodes.synopsis: In front of Shion Kiba who infiltrated the Apostles' headquarters, stands Valeos. In order to settle all pasts, Shion challenges Valeos again.
episodes.title: The Hope In Our Hands

episodes.synopsis: TRY3 heads toward the "Land of Descent", the place where the Sword Saint Fides supposedly landed at once upon a time. There, the one waiting for those three is Chrono Shindou's father.
episodes.title: The Land of Descent

episodes.synopsis: In order to completely revive Gyze, Apostles enter the North America Branch Association. Darkface, who seeks the destruction of the facility, is met by one of the members of the defense team, Misaki Tokura. Can Darkface be defeated for sure this time!?
episodes.title: Dawn of the Decisive Battle

episodes.synopsis: Aimed by Aichi Sendou and Toshiki Kai, Chaos Breaker shows itself-- In order to take back Noa Hoshizaki, what Arata Nishizawa and Makoto Asada arrived at is......!?! Aichi and Kai tags, challenging the titan that wields despair!!
episodes.title: Choice of the Jester

episodes.synopsis: A decisive battle with reverse position from before begins!! In order to rescue Kazuma Shouji, Kazumi Onimaru challenges Gyze with all of his might. Alongside Shiranui with new powers, can Kazumi catch up to Gyze......!?
episodes.title: Dragon Deity of Destruction, Gyze

episodes.synopsis: The world swallowed by "Void" and returns into nothingness, the ones who fight to prevent the world from being eroded by "Void" are vanguards, and their allies from all over the world......! The final battle of TRY3 vs Gyze begins!!
episodes.title: Void and Vanguard

episodes.synopsis:
Units that claim "apostles" from Planet Clay descended to the earth. "Ryujin gauze of destruction" to destroy everything. "Apostles" who plan their resurrection invade the earth using the power of the six dragons "Zero Dragon"!

Vanguard fighters, now stand up. Beyond fate, grasp the future under a bond that connects each other!
episodes.title: TRY3

episodes.synopsis: Confronting Gyze with TRY3's thoughts and futures on the line. Their thoughts finally awaken the power of the Dimensional Overstride!
episodes.title: Dimensional Overstride

episodes.synopsis: Following the fight with Gyze, everyone has regained their peaceful daily lifes. The Quest System has been revived anew, as the adults throw a party and go to the barbecue. And then Chrono Shindou, aiming to become an astronaut, is seen at a study group.
episodes.title: EXTRA TURN
